select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId,/**交易编号**/
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, tar.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID as assetId, /**标的债券代码**/ fp.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr,/**标的债券简称**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType,/**业务类型**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, /**业务类型Code**/ d.finprod_type as finprodTypeCode,/**借贷方向Code**/ d.PS as psCode,/**交易方向Code**/ d.PS as ps,/**交易方向**/ d.COUNTER_ID as counterId,/**交易对手**/
d.ccy as ccyCode, /**币种Code**/ d.ccy as ccy, /**币种**/ to_char(d.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as tradeDate,/**交易日**/ to_char(d.VDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as vDate,/**起息日**/ to_char(d.MDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as mDate,/*到期日*/ to_char(d.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as settleDate,/*交割日*/ ftp.TERM_TYPE as termType, /**借贷期限（天）**/ ftp.BASIS as basis,/**计费基础**/ ftp.INT_RATE*100 as intRate, /**费率**/ d.PRIN_AMT as shareAmt,/**券面总额/交易本金**/ d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, /** 交易金额 **/ d.TRADE_AMT as cdAmt, /** 借贷费用 **/ d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatusCode, /**交易状态Code**/ d.REGIST_ORG registOrg,/**登记托管机构**/ d.FEE_AMT feeAmt,/**总交易费用**/ d.FEE_AMT_PAY feeAmtPay,/**随交易支付费用**/ d.FEE_AMT_UNPAY feeAmtUnpay,/**未随交易支付费用**/ nvl(jsf.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE,'N') isPayWithTrade,/**是否随交易支付**/ d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus /**交易状态**/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL jsf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B08' left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO cust_out on cust_out.customer_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_PRODUCT cust_in on cust_in.finprod_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on ftp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and d.branch=ftp.branch and (ftp.branch_type is null and ftp.branch = '0') /**只统计接口接进来的标的信息，不统计插入该表的交易信息**/ left join FIN_DEAL_TARGET tar on tar.FINPROD_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = tar.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
